name: io.github.soke1556/zas-agent
title: Zas
description: Send files and notes from a coding agent into your Zas channels, encrypted on your machine.

packageArguments.name: --profile
packageArguments.description: Which local identity directory to use, under ~/.zas/agent/. One profile per harness, so a Claude Code agent and a Codex agent on one machine stay separate. Pair it first with: npx -y zas-agent pair --profile <name>
